subgoals.description: Research and compile a list of Edinburgh venues with key details such as name, location, capacity, price range, and amenities.
subgoals.success_criterion: List of 3-5 venues with all specified details is compiled.

subgoals.description: Draft a promotional flyer using the selected venue's details from the research.
subgoals.success_criterion: Flyer text includes venue name, location, key features, and a call to action.
